description: LEAP-GWU-2015 Laboratory Tests is a dataset listed in DesignSafe Data Depot (published projects), a research data repository for natural hazards engineering under the section "other", published or maintained by Majid Manzari, George Washington University (gwu.edu). The LEAP-2015 project was the planning phase of the Liquefaction Experiments and Analysis Projects (LEAP). As part of this project, a numerical simulation exercise was organized to assess the predictive capabilities of a number of constitutive models and numerical techniques for modeling of soil liquefaction and lateral spreading of mildly sloping grounds. Coverage: as described in the project (site or event named in the description). DesignSafe files it as a "other" project. Its DOI is 10.17603/DS2TH7Q. Keywords: Cyclic Triaxial Test, Hydraulic Conductivity, Liquefaction, Montonic Triaxial Test, Ottawa F65 Sand, Particle Size Distribution. Published 2018-10-12. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated in the DesignSafe listing (publication licences offered are CC BY 4.0, ODC-By, CC0 and GPL; project page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support structural performance, hazard exposure and resilience studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-designsafe-data-depot-repository.
